verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Cake feature for exporting a cap table or transaction history to Excel/CSV. The export articles describe getting data out of Carta and Pulley to import into Cake, which is the opposite direction. The read-only MCP query access and the live cap table view ("no spreadsheet export needed") are adjacent features, not an open-format export.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can export my complete cap table and full transaction history to open formats (Excel/CSV) at any time — my ownership data is never held hostage
